nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Reneawable energy adoption|Renewable energy financing_qna_000
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: How does the presence of multinational corporations (MNCs) influence export finance for renewables?
nodes.answer: The relationship is likely to be stronger when renewable industries are comprised of MNCs that are export-oriented with the expertise to seek out export finance.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Reneawable energy adoption|Renewable energy financing_qna_001
nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What strengthens the relationship between renewable industries and export finance?
nodes.answer: This relationship is likely to be stronger when the renewable industries consist of multinational corporations that are export-oriented and have the expertise to seek out export finance.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Sustainable consumption and production|Reneawable energy adoption|Renewable energy financing_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What factors affect the support of renewable industries by Exlm and UKEF in the US and UK?
nodes.answer: Domestic content requirements, investment support, and risk aversion have all affected the extent of support from Exlm and UKEF for renewable industries.
